lab_questions.title: Allocate Minimum Shipping Truck Capacity
lab_questions.description:
A logistics dispatcher must ship N packages stored on a conveyor belt across D days. The packages must be loaded onto trucks in the exact order they arrive on the conveyor belt. Each daily truck has a weight capacity limit, and all packages loaded on a single day cannot exceed this weight capacity.

Your task is to calculate the minimum truck weight capacity required to ship all N packages within D days.

tasks.title: Test Case 1
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 1.
Input:
6 3
10 20 30 40 50 60
Expected Output: 90

solution.python:
import sys
data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
if data:
    n, d = data[0], data[1]
    weights = data[2:n+2]
    low, high = max(weights), sum(weights)
    res = high
    while low <= high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        days = 1
        curr = 0
        for w in weights:
            if curr + w > mid:
                days += 1
                curr = 0
            curr += w
        if days <= d:
            res = mid
            high = mid - 1
        else:
            low = mid + 1
    print(res)
